## Description

Combines time-varying copulas with Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) Extreme Value Theory (EVT) modeling to price and trade relative value mispricings in index option tail risk.

## Where it may fit

Index option skew arbitrage, tail-risk hedging, volatile index option mispricings.

## Vehicles

Volatility Arbitrage Funds, Options Market Making Desks, Tail-Risk Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Intraday option chains, implied volatility skew surfaces, historical return tail panels.

## Caveats

EVT threshold selection for GPD tail fitting requires stability over varying high-quantile cutoffs.
